snippet.title: Jotunnslayer: Hordes of Hel - Official Launch Trailer | PC & Consoles
snippet.description:
JOTUNNSLAYER: HORDES OF HEL 1.0 OUT NOW!

Flagons raised. Axes hurled. Lightning unleashed. Hordes sent screaming back to Hel. After a wild Early Access ride, Jotunnslayer: Hordes of Hel is finally dropping in full force on PC, PS5, and Xbox Series X|S!

What’s new in 1.0?

Helheim Map - twisted puzzles & brutal gauntlets
New Class: Kinslayer (fallen Valkyrie with vengeance to spare)
New God: Nidhogg - massive, merciless, metal as hell
Endless Mode - how long can you actually survive?
New Boss: Half-dead, all pain

Ready to slay harder than ever?
See you in Hel! 

ENTER THE HEL NOW:
Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2820820/Jotunnslayer_Hordes_of_Hel/
Epic Games Store: https://store.epicgames.com/en-US/p/jotunnslayer-hordes-of-hel-3579b3
PlayStation 5: https://store.playstation.com/en-us/concept/10015542
Xbox Series X|S: https://www.xbox.com/en-US/games/store/jotunnslayer-hordes-of-hel/9nxtls86cvtq
